description: Runtime dependency API surface declarations for dependency SDKs consumed by SDKWork Claw Router. sdkDependencies owns generation boundaries; this manifest owns runtime mount/base-url decisions.

evidence: services/sdkwork-claw-app-api/src/lib.rs merges app_sessions_router, app_user_profile_router, and app_iam_directory_router in database-backed runtime paths.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/app_auth.rs declares /app/v3/api/auth/* and /app/v3/api/system/iam/* handler adapters; appbase-owned OAuth runtime is consumed through sdkwork-appbase app SDK surfaces under /app/v3/api/oauth/*.
services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/app_user_profile.rs declares /app/v3/api/iam/users/current.
services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/app_iam_directory.rs declares appbase IAM directory read routes under /app/v3/api/iam/*.
sdks/clawrouter-app-sdk/openapi/clawrouter-app-sdk.openapi.json records sdkwork-appbase-app-sdk exclusions so generated Claw Router app SDK stays owner-only.
Commerce app API routes are owned by sdkwork-commerce and consumed through sdkwork-commerce-app-sdk.
Claw Router portal bootstrap derives VITE_SDKWORK_COMMERCE_APP_API_BASE_URL from PORTAL_PUBLIC_SDK_BASE_URL + /app/v3/api when no Commerce-specific override is configured.
No Claw Router runtime mount coverage is declared for Commerce app API handlers.

productOwnedOperationOverrides.evidence: services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_user.rs create_api_key builds Claw Router gateway API key secrets, hashes, audit records, and idempotency.
services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_user.rs delete_api_key deletes Claw Router gateway API keys through the product AdminUserStore.

verified.evidence: services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_appbase_backend_iam.rs and services/sdkwork-claw-admin-api/src/lib.rs mount SQL-backed IAM directory adapters in database-configured admin runtime.
services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_user.rs serves appbase backend IAM user aliases from AdminUserStore.
services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_user.rs serves appbase backend IAM API key aliases with Claw Router API key secret ownership for create/delete.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_appbase_backend_iam_oauth.rs serves appbase backend IAM OAuth resources through SQL-backed iam_oauth_* tables; services/sdkwork-claw-admin-api/src/lib.rs mounts it in the database-configured admin runtime; services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/infrastructure/sql/installer.rs applies appbase IAM OAuth SQL tables and indexes from sdkwork_iam_storage_sqlx.

evidence: sdkwork_iam_http backend_routes() is used only as dependency route metadata for appbase backend IAM path coverage; its local/demo backend router is not mounted as Claw Router runtime coverage.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_appbase_backend_iam.rs serves backend IAM directory, organization, membership, department, assignment, position, role, permission, role-permission, and role-binding routes through AppIamDirectoryReadStore plus SQLite/Postgres SQL command/read stores with no demo success or 501 command fallback.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_appbase_backend_iam_oauth.rs serves backend IAM OAuth provider catalog, integrations, flow configs, resource accounts, resource authorizations, webhooks, operational resources, callback events, and diagnostic runs through real iam_oauth_* SQL tables.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/api/admin_user.rs serves GET/POST/PATCH /backend/v3/api/iam/users and GET/POST/DELETE /backend/v3/api/iam/api_keys through the real AdminUserStore and Claw Router API key secret pipeline.

services/sdkwork-claw-admin-api/src/lib.rs mounts the SQL-backed appbase backend IAM directory and OAuth adapters only when database-backed stores and the admin subject boundary are configured; the default no-database router does not mount demo IAM routes.

services/sdkwork-claw-product/src/infrastructure/sql/installer.rs applies appbase IAM OAuth schema statements from sdkwork_iam_storage_sqlx::iam_initial_migration_sql() for iam_oauth_* tables and indexes.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-product --test admin_appbase_backend_iam_api admin_appbase_backend_iam_directory_reads_sql_tables_without_demo_data verifies organization, role, and permission reads from SQL tables with no org_demo data.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-product --test admin_appbase_backend_iam_api admin_appbase_backend_iam_oauth_reads_and_writes_sql_tables_without_demo_data verifies OAuth provider catalog, flow config, resource account, integration command, diagnostic, and delete paths against SQL tables with no demo data.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-product --test admin_user_api admin_user_route_serves_appbase_backend_iam_users_from_store verifies users and API keys are served from AdminUserStore and not local-admin/sk-local demo data.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-admin-api --test contract_routes appbase_backend_iam_routes_are_not_demo_mounted_without_database_runtime verifies the default admin router does not expose demo appbase backend IAM data.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-admin-api --test database_config_router database_config_router_serves_backend_sdk_contract_aliases verifies database-configured admin runtime returns store-backed users and API keys through appbase backend IAM aliases.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-admin-api --test database_config_router database_config_router_serves_appbase_backend_iam_from_real_sql_runtime verifies database-configured admin runtime returns SQL-backed appbase backend IAM organizations, roles, permissions, and role permissions with no org_demo data.

cargo test -p sdkwork-claw-admin-api --test database_config_router database_config_router_serves_appbase_backend_iam_oauth_from_real_sql_runtime verifies database-configured admin runtime returns SQL-backed appbase backend IAM OAuth provider catalog rows with no demo data.
Commerce backend API routes are owned by sdkwork-commerce and consumed through sdkwork-commerce-backend-sdk plus @sdkwork/commerce-service.
Claw Router portal bootstrap derives VITE_SDKWORK_COMMERCE_BACKEND_API_BASE_URL from PORTAL_PUBLIC_SDK_BASE_URL + /backend/v3/api when no Commerce-specific override is configured.
No Claw Router runtime mount coverage is declared for Commerce backend API handlers.
